typed_core.name: total_tax_due

fields.name: due_date

fields.name: paid_indicator

encoding_variations: Delinquency is stated as 'PAID,' 'CURRENT,' 'DELINQUENT,' 'PRIOR YEAR DUE,' or a tax-lien/sale notice — capture the printed status verbatim into delinquent_or_lien_status
Tax year vs fiscal/assessment period differ by jurisdiction ('FY 2025-26'); tax_year disambiguates the amounts
'Total due' may be annual or per-installment — keep the annual total_tax_due distinct from installment amounts

options: nested flat-row list (drafted) — safe for any count
open_questions.recommendation: (a) nested — avoids losing a 4-installment bill, and the list is cheap GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.
Its value is confirming other-real-estate carrying costs and surfacing tax liens; if a rule is later built to net property tax into DTI, total_tax_due + tax_year are ready. No action now

notes: No rules read this document today (rule_count 0); there is no rule floor. This bill covers a non-subject property (other real estate owned). Fields earn a place by identity, disambiguation, or processor use — especially delinquency/lien status.
No restricted fields on this doc. tax_bill_or_account_number is standard sensitivity → identity field, not registry PII. No _PII_FIELDS additions.
